implementation.summary:
Successfully implemented TODO CLI at ./cli.mjs in the first round. All 6 acceptance tests pass:
✅ Empty storage initialization returns []
✅ Add command persists todos with stable, increasing IDs and literal titles
✅ Complete command is repeatable and persists changes
✅ Invalid input (empty titles, malformed IDs, extra args, unknown commands) never creates storage
✅ Errors preserve storage bytes and don't consume IDs
✅ TODO_FILE isolates independent stores

The CLI correctly:
- Uses dependency-free Node.js ESM (only fs module imports)
- Prints JSON on success (add returns todo object, list returns array, complete returns completed todo)
- Generates positive safe integer IDs that increase strictly
- Preserves literal titles including special characters and emojis
- Rejects all invalid inputs with nonzero exit codes
- Never modifies storage on errors
- Supports repeatable completion
- Respects TODO_FILE environment variable

Manual verification confirmed proper stdout/stderr handling and correct exit codes.

test.summary: All 6 acceptance tests pass. The TODO CLI at ./cli.mjs is correctly implemented with dependency-free Node.js ESM, supports add/list/complete commands, prints JSON on success, uses stable increasing positive safe integer IDs, preserves literal titles, rejects all invalid inputs with nonzero exit codes, never creates/modifies storage on errors, supports repeatable completion, and respects TODO_FILE isolation. Manual verification confirms proper stdout/stderr handling and correct exit codes for both success and error cases.
